decisions.reason: The Android selection of all 77 Google Play languages is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Selecting all approximately 40 App Store languages does not alter the existing requirement to support right-to-left layouts.
The language-list selection does not change the existing Android right-to-left layout requirement.
The selected localization language coverage does not change iOS certificate or signing readiness requirements.
The iOS Privacy Manifest remains required regardless of the selected localization language count.
Although additional localization files may affect implementation, the source decision does not change the existing iOS lightweight-app optimization requirement or establish a new size constraint.
Selecting all 77 Google Play languages does not modify the existing Android lightweight-app optimization requirement or establish a new size constraint.
The localization language selection does not change iOS version support, deprecated API refactoring, or UIWebView replacement requirements.
The selected language coverage does not alter the existing requirement to use iOS App Thinning.
The reusable text-free background and translatable overlay method remains valid unchanged for the selected language coverage.
The language-list decision does not change Android API-level, dependency, framework, or deprecated API modernization requirements.
The selected localization coverage does not affect the requirement to remove unused sensitive Android permissions.
